whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Mardi Bakery and Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has a great location in PC Colony Kankarbagh, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online menu browsing and cake orders.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake pre-ordering, menu gallery, aur location/directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mardi

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Mardi Bakery and Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and a digital menu for Kankarbagh customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual bakery photos aur menu items integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
